# falldental

> falldental · sovereign single-file tool · @ai-native-solutions

falldental is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
